title: InDusk Worktree Per-Repo Config
description: Shape of .indusk/worktree-configs/<repo>.json — per-wrapped-repo source of truth for the worktree extension. See apps/indusk-mcp/extensions/worktree/skill.md.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for IDE/LSP support; validator ignores it

trunk_branch.description: Branch name the trunk symlink tracks (typically 'main' or 'master')

base_branch.description: Default base branch new worktrees branch off (typically same as trunk_branch)

copy_files.description: Files copied from canonical clone into a new worktree at create time

append_files.description: Files concatenated onto existing destination files under a sentinel header at create time

apply_commits.description: Upstream-file-overlay entries. Each names a SHA and a file list; the file contents at <sha> are written into the worktree and marked skip-worktree (invisible to git status).

preflight.description: Preflight commands. Each runs against CHANGED_FILES + preflight_env-derived booleans. Failures exit preflight non-zero.

when.description: Env var name that must be truthy for this preflight item to run (optional; omit to always run)

preflight_env.description: Declarative path filters. For each key, glob-match patterns against CHANGED_FILES; export the key as truthy on match.

compose_project_name.description: Recommended value for ce.json's top-level composeProjectName field (composable.env ≥ 1.37.7). Pins docker-compose project name for cross-cwd targeting. One stack per repo at a time.
